t: The Federal facility located at the South Mississippi Branch Experiment Station in Poplarville, Mississippi, and known as the “Southern Horticultural Laboratory”, shall be known and designated as the “Thad Cochran Southern Horticultural Laboratory”: Provided, That any reference in law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to such Federal facility shall be deemed to be a reference to the “Thad Cochran Southern Horticultural Laboratory”.

fable.w: This section only renames a federal facility and deems existing references in federal records to refer to the new name. The tempting reading is that the word "regulation" signals rulemaking, but it appears only in a boilerplate list of records in which the old name is to be read as the new one; it does not authorize or require any regulation. No party outside the federal government is consulted or given a role in any federal decision.
fable.s: shall be known and designated as the “Thad Cochran Southern Horticultural Laboratory”

opus.w: This section only renames a federal facility and says that existing references to it now mean the new name. The word "regulation" appears only in a list of documents that refer to the facility. It does not give or require any power to issue rules. No one outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a way to object before any federal decision.
